1879076075.name: Fellowship's Heart
1879076075.desc: Provides a Heal-over-time to the Fellowship and removes Fear effects.\n\nAllies in range will become immune to Fear effect for 10s.

1879107947.desc: The ridicule a Rune-keeper writes hurts more than a mundane scribe's ever could. The damage over time tiers up on subsequent uses.

1879139051.name: Swipe
1879139051.desc: You swipe at the target quickly. This attack cannot be evaded.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879146219.name: Final Word
1879146219.desc: Interrupts inductions being performed by the foe.

1879166827.name: Passage of Foes
1879166827.desc: Allows you to track the presence of nearby Orcs, trolls, giants, and evil Men or dwarves.

1879193067.name: Muster in Harndirion
1879193067.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Harndirion in Enedwaith.

1879198315.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Tundra Cub)
1879198315.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879201259.name: Improved Lethargic Poison
1879201259.desc: Your hatchling injects your target with poison, causing severe lethargy.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Consumes Venomous Haze to increase incoming damage by 5% for 30s.</rgb>

1879228139.name: Fist and Fist
1879228139.desc: Capable Wardens doubly prepare their fist for attack.

1879232491.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Cub)
1879232491.desc: While forsaken in life, in death, this young cub stands solidly by your side.

1879240811.name: a mounted ranged attack
1879240811.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a bow.

1879244907.name: Improved Rune of Restoration
1879244907.desc: Places a stone covered with runes of restoration, power, and grace upon the ground. The stone cannot be healed. A Rune-keeper may only have one stone active at a time.

1879272555.name: Massive Chicken Hit
1879272555.desc: One long bomb and the chicken has flown the coop.

1879274091.name: Snap Shot - Improved Hampering Javelin
1879274091.desc: A precise throw can pin a target to the ground and hinder its movement for a short while thereafter.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879275755.name: Serrated
1879275755.desc: Your senses sharpen as you seek out the weaknesses in your enemy's defences.

1879315051.name: Black-beak Cave-claw
1879315051.desc: Summons a black-beak cave-claw to help you search for riches!

1879315179.name: Mark of Beorn
1879315179.desc: A mark that can be placed on an enemy. This mark will interact with various skills, altering or increasing their potency.

1879316843.name: Execute
1879316843.desc: Consume remaining Wrath to deal a massive amount of damage. Can not miss or be blocked, parried, or evaded.

1879368171.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Aurochs)
1879368171.desc: Summons an aurochs companion.\n\nAurochs are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879368811.name: Perfect Picnic Steed
1879368811.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879387115.name: Travelling Goat of the Mountain Meadow
1879387115.desc: A goat dressed to celebrate spring.

1879394411.name: Shepherd Dog
1879394411.desc: Brings out a shepherd dog to keep you company.

1879404779.name: Steed of Ungwetári's Bane
1879404779.desc: A steed with courage enough to visit one of the darkest places in Middle-earth.

1879418603.name: Cozy Grey Cat
1879418603.desc: Summons a cuddly, cozy grey cat to keep you company.

1879428075.name: Throw
1879428075.desc: Throw a random object at your target, lowering its defences with a stack of Rattled. Rattled can stack up to 3 times.

1879449579.desc: Anthem: Increases Incoming Healing and Outgoing Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879449835.name: Grisly Cry (Dual)
1879449835.desc: Your roar causes even the staunchest enemies to run in fear.

1879458539.name: Masterful Strike (To Arms)
1879458539.desc: Strike your foe with immense force, increasing your damage greatly for a brief time.

1879464171.name: Return to Pelargir
1879464171.desc: You're able to quickly return to Pelargir in King's Gondor. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879470571.name: Quick Strike
1879470571.desc: A quick strike which restores some of your morale.

1879494123.name: Guise of Mordirith
1879494123.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Mordirith, the False King of Angmar. You just keep coming back to this one!

1879497707.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497707.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506667.name: Frost-spike
1879506667.desc: Send a spike of ice at your target. In so doing, you are covered in an icy shell.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879507819.name: Mischievous Diversion
1879507819.desc: Divert the enemy's attention and enter Combat Stealth.

1879523179.name: Broad Remorseless Strike
1879523179.desc:
Uses fervour to deal a devastating attack.

This attack is hard to defend.

Critical hits deal massive damage. 
 
 Critical hits will reset Emboldened Blades.
